newsitem.title: USA: Global One names new president, CFO.
newsitem.headline: Global One names new president, CFO.

text.p: Global One Distribution & Merchandising Inc said Friday it has appointed George Vrabeck president. It also named Walter Lacher chief financial officer.
Vrabeck is the former chief executive of Kelly Russell Studios Inc. He joined Global One in August as executive vice president upon the completion of the merger of Kelly Russell into the company.
The president's position is newly created.
Lacher most recently was corporate controller for Global One.
The previous chief financial officer, who was not immediately identified, resigned.
